threat_event: Takeover of the ticketing platform administrator account (credential stuffing or phishing) leads to a patron export, changed event pages or prices, or a changed payout bank account
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No MFA on SYS-01; password reused on the website; the marketing assistant signs in with the owner's login; activity log never reviewed
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-01 ticketing platform; BP-02 ticket sales; payouts
likelihood_basis: EV-002 (SYS-01 MFA off); EV-028 (shared password; assistant uses the owner's login; log not reviewed); EV-001 (no named sub-users)
existing_controls: Email (the reset route) has MFA; payout-change alert email to the owner
treatment_plan: Turn on SYS-01 MFA; unique passphrases in a password manager; named sub-users with limited roles for the assistant and door staff; monthly activity log review; payout-change alerts also to the owner's phone

threat_event: Card-skimming script placed on the website pages that embed the checkout (through the website login or a third-party plugin) steals patrons' card data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Website login has no MFA and shares the SYS-01 password; a former assistant was still an administrator until 2026-07-29; 3 unreviewed third-party scripts, including a chat plugin that can add code to every page; nobody checks the pages for changes
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-03 website; hosted checkout widget; BP-02
likelihood_basis: EV-011 (website MFA off; three third-party scripts); EV-039 (browser capture 2026-07-28); EV-SA-9 (former assistant still a website administrator)
regulatory_driver: N71-R04 (SAQ A script eligibility criterion; PCI DSS Req 6.4.3; 11.6.1; 12.10); Fla. Stat. 501.171(4)
existing_controls: Payment fields come from the processor inside the widget; former administrator removed 2026-07-29
treatment_plan: Website MFA and unique password; remove the pixel and chat plugin from event pages; approved script list; monthly page check; or link to the vendor's hosted event pages instead of embedding

threat_event: Card numbers sent by fans or keyed by the owner (phone orders on the laptop; emails and texts with card numbers and security codes) are exposed through the mailbox, the phone, or a compromised laptop, and make the SAQ A attestation untrue
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Phone orders keyed into the SYS-01 box office screen on the laptop; 23 emails and 4 texts with card numbers found 2026-07-28 (19 with security codes); no rule against accepting card details
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-04 email; SYS-07 laptop and phone; BP-02
likelihood_basis: EV-005 (about 120 box office orders); EV-028 (phone orders keyed on the laptop); EV-040 (card number search 2026-07-28)
regulatory_driver: N71-R04 (PCI DSS Req 3.2; 3.3; SAQ A eligibility); Fla. Stat. 501.171(1)(g)
existing_controls: Emails and texts deleted 2026-07-31; email MFA; laptop encryption
treatment_plan: Payment links instead of keyed phone orders (2026-09-01); website and order-email notice never to send card details; reply-and-delete rule for any card data received; re-search the mailbox before signing the SAQ

threat_event: The 2025 SAQ A attestation was untrue and the 2026 one is signed the same way, so the processor imposes fees, ends the merchant account, or passes card brand assessments after a compromise
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: SAQ A answered 'yes' throughout without checking eligibility; no PCI DSS scope description; owner unaware of the merchant agreement's terms
likelihood_basis: EV-009 (2025 SAQ A answered yes throughout); EV-027 (no scope description); EV-047 (merchant agreement review)
regulatory_driver: N71-R04 (PCI DSS Req 12.5; SAQ A eligibility; AOC)
treatment_plan: Write a one-page PCI scope description; close the eligibility gaps (R-002, R-003) before signing the 2026 SAQ A; answer each question with evidence in a folder; ask the processor how to correct the 2025 answers if counsel advises

threat_event: Patron exports (about 14,000 records) are disclosed through public share links, the laptop, or the email marketing account
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 19 monthly exports kept; 4 had 'anyone with the link' sharing (turned off 2026-07-28); no retention rule; email marketing login shared with the assistant
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-04 files; SYS-05 email marketing; SYS-07 laptop
likelihood_basis: EV-042 (19 exports; 4 public share links); EV-015 (email marketing login shared with the assistant)
existing_controls: Laptop encryption; email MFA; share links turned off
treatment_plan: Keep only the latest export and delete it after upload; named sharing only; assistant gets its own email marketing login with MFA

threat_event: Door staff misuse the shared scanner login to look up patrons, or a scanning phone is lost with the login on it
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One shared door login unchanged since 2024; scanner role can search orders by name and email
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-01 scanner app; SYS-07 scanning phones; BP-01
likelihood_basis: EV-001 (shared door login unchanged since 2024; scanner role searches orders); EV-019 (scanning phones)
existing_controls: Passcode and 1-minute lock; phones kept in the locked office
treatment_plan: Scan-only role without order search; door login changed after each contractor staff change; the door lead signs out the phones each show night

threat_event: Someone on the shared Wi-Fi (touring crew device or guest) attacks the laptop, scanning phones, or router
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One Wi-Fi network for business devices, crews, and artists; password posted backstage; router default administrator password until 2026-07-29
likelihood_basis: EV-020 (one network; password posted backstage); EV-048 (show-night walk-through); EV-IA-5 (router default password)
regulatory_driver: N71-R04 (PCI DSS Req 1.3; 2.3, until keyed phone orders stop); N71-R05 (15 U.S.C. 45(n))
existing_controls: SaaS traffic uses TLS; host firewall on; router password changed 2026-07-29
treatment_plan: Separate guest network for crews and artists; business network password not posted; scanning phones on the business network only

threat_event: Ticketing platform outage during an on-sale or on a show night
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single SaaS dependency for sales and door scanning
likelihood_basis: EV-031 (vendor availability commitments); EV-032 (scanner app offline mode); EV-034 (owner BIA worksheet)
existing_controls: Vendor availability commitments (SOC 2, P09); scanner app works offline with the downloaded list
treatment_plan: Accepted: residual risk Low. Download and print the attendee list before doors; postpone an on-sale if the platform is down

threat_event: The owner is suddenly unavailable or loses the phone holding the authenticator app, so nobody can run doors, settle with artists, refund fans, or reach the accounts
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Owner holds every role and credential; only one authenticator device; no backup promoter arrangement
likelihood_basis: EV-018 (one authenticator device; no recovery codes); EV-034 (owner holds every role)
existing_controls: Recovery codes for email, processor, and accounting sealed with the owner's attorney (2026-07-31)
treatment_plan: Named sub-users for door and marketing; show-night card for the door lead; add SYS-01 and website recovery codes to the envelope; backup promoter arrangement (P05)

threat_event: A compromise is not recognized, or the processor's 24-hour notice, card brand steps, or breach notice deadlines are missed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No incident plan or contact list; owner did not know the merchant agreement's notice term; no security training
likelihood_basis: EV-027 (no incident plan or contact list); EV-047 (owner unaware of the 24-hour term); EV-028 (no security training)
treatment_plan: Adopt the P08 runbook and printed contact list; walk through it with the IT consultant; annual security course

threat_event: Advertised ticket prices leave out mandatory fees, so the FTC treats the ads as unfair and deceptive under the fee rule
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 17 of 20 sampled social posts and all 6 flyers show '$X plus fees'; smart pricing makes posted prices stale
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-05 social and email; flyers; BP-03
likelihood_basis: EV-046 (17 of 20 posts and all 6 flyers); EV-004 (smart pricing on 8 shows)
existing_controls: SYS-01 event pages and checkout show the total price
treatment_plan: Show the total price in every post, email, flyer, and website listing; a one-line posting checklist for the assistant; link posts to the live event page when smart pricing is on

threat_event: Smart pricing or bot protection treats fans unfairly or breaks commitments: prices above artist caps, accessible seating priced above the same section, or real fans blocked with no appeal
threat_source: Ticketing vendor AI features (as configured by the owner)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Auto-apply mode with no floors or ceilings; no rule keeping accessible seating at parity; no appeal route for blocked fans
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-01 smart pricing and bot protection; BP-02
likelihood_basis: EV-004 (auto-apply with no floors or ceilings); EV-037 (price change history: 1 cap breach); EV-028 (no review before turning it on)
existing_controls: Owner can pause the feature per show; 1 cap breach found and noted
treatment_plan: Suggest-only mode with owner approval; artist caps as ceilings; accessible seating excluded from automatic changes; published appeal route (P10)

threat_event: A ticketing vendor or processor breach exposes patron or card data, or the vendor's compliance lapses unnoticed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor PCI DSS status never checked before 2026-07-28; no list of who does which PCI DSS requirement; no agreed incident notice time from the ticketing vendor
likelihood_basis: EV-027 (no AOC or provider list on file); EV-044; EV-045 (AOCs obtained 2026-07-28); EV-031 (vendor SOC 2 report)
treatment_plan: Annual AOC and SOC 2 check each July; written responsibility list; ask the vendor for its customer incident notice time

threat_event: Fake agent or artist payment instructions (business email compromise) redirect a deposit or settlement
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Deposits and settlements paid on emailed bank details with no call-back check
likelihood_basis: EV-035 (risk walk-through: payments on emailed bank details with no call-back)
treatment_plan: Confirm any new or changed bank details by phone at a known number before paying; note the check in the accounting entry

threat_event: A hurricane or building closure cancels shows for several days
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single room; shows booked weeks ahead
existing_controls: SYS-01 handles mass refunds and rescheduling; systems are cloud-hosted
treatment_plan: Accepted: residual risk Low. Follow the platform's cancellation steps and announce from the event pages
